SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count,
COUNT( CASE WHEN status_code = '01' THEN 1 END ) AS draft_count,
COUNT( CASE WHEN status_code = '02' THEN 1 END ) AS reviewing_count,
COUNT( CASE WHEN status_code = '03' THEN 1 END ) AS approved_count,
COUNT( CASE WHEN status_code = '04' THEN 1 END ) AS rejected_count FROM loan_application WHERE is_deleted = 'N'

SELECT TO_CHAR(d.application_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS application_date, COUNT(la.application_id) AS application_count FROM( SELECT TRUNC( CAST( SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS DATE ) ) - (7 - LEVEL) AS application_date FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 7 ) d
LEFT JOIN loan_application la ON la.applied_at >= d.application_date AND la.applied_at < d.application_date + 1 AND la.is_deleted = 'N'
GROUP BY d.application_date
ORDER BY d.application_date ASC

WITH date_range AS ( SELECT CAST( TRUNC( CAST( SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS DATE) ) - 6 AS TIMESTAMP ) AS start_at, CAST( TRUNC( CAST( SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS DATE) ) + 1 AS TIMESTAMP ) AS end_at FROM dual ),
-- 1단계: 신청서 생성 created AS ( SELECT application_id, MIN(occurred_at) AS created_at FROM user_activity_log CROSS JOIN date_range WHERE event_type = 'APPLICATION_CREATE' AND application_id IS NOT NULL AND occurred_at >= start_at AND occurred_at < end_at GROUP BY application_id ),
-- 2단계: 신청서 생성 이후 한도 조회 limit_checked AS ( SELECT l.application_id, MIN(L.occurred_at) AS checked_at FROM user_activity_log l INNER JOIN created c ON l.application_id = c.application_id CROSS JOIN date_range d WHERE l.event_type = 'LIMIT_CHECK' AND l.occurred_at >= c.created_At AND l.occurred_at < d.end_at GROUP BY l.application_id ),
-- 3단계: 한도 조회 이후 최종 제출 submitted AS ( SELECT DISTINCT s.application_id FROM user_activity_log s INNER JOIN limit_checked l ON s.application_id = l.application_id CROSS JOIN date_range d WHERE s.event_type = 'APPLICATION_SUBMIT' AND s.occurred_at >= l.checked_at AND s.occurred_at < d.end_at )
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM created) AS application_create_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM limit_checked) AS limit_check_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM submitted) AS application_submit_count FROM dual
